idea-plugin.name: DocViewKit Omni
idea-plugin.description:
Open Office documents, PDFs, iWork files, OpenDocument files, and more directly in your JetBrains IDE. DocViewKit Omni is a fast, private, read-only document viewer powered by DocViewKit Viewer.

  • Broad format support, free: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, RTF, CSV, OpenDocument, Apple Pages/Numbers/Keynote, legacy Office, WPS Office, XPS, and related formats.
  • Documents stay local: parsing, rendering, and search run inside the IDE. The plugin does not upload documents or send file names and paths to a remote service.
  • No conversion server: preview files without a document-conversion backend.
  • Fast and lightweight: format components load on demand for faster startup and lower resource use.
  • Useful document tools: navigate, zoom, search, select text, follow safe links, and switch interaction modes where supported.
  • Safe, read-only viewing: active document content is not executed, and isolated resource failures do not unnecessarily hide the rest of the document.
  • IDE-native behavior: files load through IntelliJ Platform APIs, refresh when changed, and follow the IDE theme and language.

Supported formats: DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, DOTM, DOC, RTF, WPS; XLSX, XLSM, XLTX, XLTM, XLS, CSV, ET; PPTX, PPTM, PPSX, PPSM, POTX, POTM, PPT, DPS; ODT, OTT, FODT, ODS, OTS, FODS, ODP, OTP, FODP; Pages, Numbers, Keynote; PDF, XPS, and OXPS.

The free Viewer includes every available format and retains DocViewKit branding.
